patch: SAY IT ABOUT THIS FRAME. When the claim is that something is HIDDEN, BLOCKED or
UNREADABLE, "it is standard", "it is normal composition", "it is intentional framing",
"trees naturally cover the ground" and "that is how games do it" are NOT refutations —
they say why the art is that way, not that the player can see the thing. For those
claims either point at the thing in the frame and say you can see it, or uphold the
claim. Style and taste remain valid grounds for every other kind of claim.

claims.origWhy: The outer boundary of the dark paved platform features raw, stair-stepped grid edges without smooth curves or blending.

claims.desc: The paved floor has sharp rectangular cutouts around the stone pillars that reveal bare dirt underneath.
claims.origWhy: A sharp rectangular section of the pavement flooring around the pillar structure is missing, exposing unrefined dirt beneath.

claims.where: pavement in front of wooden bench
claims.desc: A sharp square cutout in the paved surface exposes grass and dirt directly in front of the bench structure.
claims.origWhy: There is a distinct rectangular cutout in the dark pavement mesh in front of and beneath the bench structure showing bare ground.

claims.where: outer edge of the dark stone platform
claims.desc: The boundary of the central platform features jagged, blocky grid steps that contrast unnaturally with the organic environment.
claims.origWhy: The circular platform's border is composed of jagged, blocky tile steps that clash with the natural grass ground.

claims.desc: Extremely dark shadows obscure the environment and foliage on the left side of the screen, hiding terrain features.
claims.origWhy: The deep shadows on the left are a normal result of low-key directional lighting in a night setting, not an artistic flaw.

claims.where: along the left and bottom edges of the central dark patio
claims.desc: The perimeter of the dark pavement uses a harsh, blocky stepped mesh boundary that cuts unnaturally into the grass terrain.
claims.origWhy: The patio edge displays harsh, blocky stepped cuts against the surrounding grass mesh.

claims.where: around the stone pillars and altar near the back wall
claims.desc: The pillars sit over unrefined rectangular cutouts in the patio flooring that expose raw ground gaps.
claims.origWhy: The pavement mesh features unrefined rectangular gaps around the stone pillar bases that expose raw ground.

A.why: The boundary of the dark paved patio clearly shows raw, unblended stair-stepped grid geometry.
Sharp, unfinished rectangular cutouts in the floor mesh around the stone pillars expose the underlying ground.
A square hole in the dark pavement mesh is clearly visible right in front of the bench.
The perimeter of the patio platform consists of obvious blocky grid steps that fail to blend with the surrounding terrain.
Deep shadows beneath tree canopies are a normal atmospheric lighting choice for dark fantasy environments rather than a technical defect.
The harsh, stair-stepped edges along the patio perimeter cut visually into the grass without any edge blending or trim.
Unrefined rectangular holes in the pavement around the rear shrine pillars expose raw dirt underneath.
